start.title: Get started
start.heading: Connect the marketplace
start.intro: Three steps. Add the marketplace as a source first, then install individual plugins.
start.step1Text: Registers this catalog as a plugin source in your Claude Code. Once per machine.
start.step2Text: Install any plugin from this marketplace by name.
start.step3Text: Refresh the marketplace to pick up new plugins and versions, then run /reload-plugins.
start.noteText: The first refreshes the list of plugins and versions the marketplace offers. The second updates the code of one installed plugin: {command}. Automatic updates are off by default; turn them on in {menu}.
